# criblio_regex (Resource)

Regex Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "criblio_regex" "my_regex" {
  description = "Regex Library entry that matches IPv4 addresses"
  group_id = "default"
  id = "ipv4-address"
  lib = "custom"
  regex = "\\b(?:\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}\\b"
  sample_data = "Connection from 192.168.1.1 on port 8080"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tools/codegen -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Worker group ID.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Regex Library entry.
- `regex` (String) Regular expression pattern.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Brief description of the Regex Library entry.
- `lib` (String) Library classification for the Regex Library entry.
- `sample_data` (String) Optionally, paste in sample data to match against this regex
- `tags` (String) Comma-separated list of tags for the Regex Library entry.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = criblio_regex.my_criblio_regex
  id = jsonencode({
    group_id = "Cribl"
    id       = "apache"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import criblio_regex.my_criblio_regex '{"group_id": "Cribl", "id": "apache"}'
```
